screenshotsAndInteractions.details: Both private local E2E passes succeeded. Screenshots 140/142 show the legacy OFF compositions; 189/191 show the Oorva ON compositions. People review readback is captured in 141/190. Documents readback is captured in 143/192: after one confirmed scoped-document rejection, only the general credential remains and the Document rejected toast is visible. The test cancels and then confirms provider/document actions, verifies one scoped provider review and one document mutation, verifies private signed preview handling and queue readback, and restores the private feature flags. UI actions use deterministic browser-local fixtures; the owner/admin state-and-reason comparison and non-admin RPC denial use the authenticated private local backend. Console errors were recorded in the pass reports but did not produce page errors, HTTP failures, or failed steps.
